summary: Multi-provider shipping integration testing completed successfully. All 19 backend API tests pass. Frontend UI testing confirms shipping rates are displayed, selectable, and correctly applied to order totals. Free shipping appears first when order qualifies (>$100). Shipping providers are MOCKED (using fallback rates) since no real API keys are configured.
critical_code_review_comments: Shipping rates endpoint queries ALL enabled providers and deduplicates similar services keeping cheapest
Fallback rates used when no providers configured - MOCKED: Shippo, EasyPost, ShipStation APIs
Free shipping logic correctly checks order_subtotal >= free_shipping_threshold ($100)
selected_shipping field correctly persisted in orders collection
Rates sorted by price with free shipping always appearing first when eligible
CheckoutPage.jsx correctly fetches rates on address change and auto-selects cheapest option
test_credentials: No special credentials needed for checkout flow
seed_data_creation: Test orders created with selected_shipping details during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Multi-provider shipping integration is functional with MOCKED provider APIs (fallback rates). Shipping method selection works in checkout Step 2. Free shipping threshold is $100. The following shipping options are available: FREE Ground Shipping (5 days), USPS Priority Mail $8.50 (2-3 days), USPS Express $26.50 (1-2 days).

mocked_functionality.shipping_provider_apis: Shippo, EasyPost, and ShipStation APIs are MOCKED - fallback rates are used since no real API keys are configured. When real API keys are added, the system will query all enabled providers and return actual rates.

verified_features: Shipping rates API returns rates from all enabled providers (fallback when none configured)
Free shipping appears first when order qualifies (>$100 threshold)
User can select shipping method in checkout Step 2
Order summary sidebar shows selected shipping method and cost
Shipping cost correctly applied to order total
Checkout validates shipping method selection before proceeding to payment
